patches.title: Three Empties Switch
patches.principle: After opening three containers of the same type without finding the target, switch to a different container type.
patches.when_to_apply: When searching for an object and containers yield nothing.

patches.title: Return to Previous Found Location
patches.principle: After placing the first object, return to the exact location where it was found to search for the second.
patches.when_to_apply: When task requires placing two identical objects and first is placed.

patches.title: Hold Object Before Sink
patches.principle: Do not go to the sink unless you are holding the object that needs cleaning.
patches.when_to_apply: When a cleaning task is active and you are not holding the target.
